Actions.use_case: Retrieving the list of flexible servers or retrieving the properties for the specified flexible server.
Checking if a flexible server name is available before provisioning.

Provisioning the temporary flexible server via point-in-time restore. Subscription scope is required because Azure runs a linked-authorization check for this action on the source server, which can be in any resource group in the subscription.
Deleting the temporary flexible server after backup data extraction is complete.
Retrieving the list of firewall rules for the specified flexible server.
Creating firewall rules on the source server to allow Exocompute pod access when using public access.
Removing firewall rules from the server during teardown.
Read the properties of the User-Assigned Managed Identity (UMI) before assigning it.
Assign the UMI to the target Azure Postgres flexible server, giving it an identity to access Key Vault.
Join the temporary export server NIC into the delegated subnet for a VNet-injected (private-access) source (Azure VNet-integration requirement).

Reading server configuration parameters (e.g. azure.extensions) on the source flexible server during backup. Subscription scope because the source server can be in any resource group in the subscription.
Setting server configuration parameters on the temporary flexible server -- allow-listing the pg_prewarm extension via azure.extensions so the backup warm-up can hydrate the restored disk.

Reading the storage_used Azure Monitor metric on the source flexible server to report FETB used-bytes for cloud-native storage reporting. Subscription scope because the source server can be in any resource group in the subscription.
Registering the Rubrik service principal as a Microsoft Entra administrator on the temporary flexible server so backups authenticate with a short-lived Entra token instead of a generated password.
Confirming that the Microsoft Entra administrator registration completed before the backup connects.

Restarting the temporary export server after writing the source server's shared_preload_libraries, which is PGC_POSTMASTER scope and takes effect only once the postmaster is cycled. Issued only when the source's list adds a library the temporary server does not already load.
